SELECT po.id, po.putaway_order_no AS putawayOrderNo,
po.receipt_order_id AS receiptOrderId, ro.receipt_order_no AS receiptOrderNo,
po.inbound_order_id AS inboundOrderId, io.inbound_order_no AS inboundOrderNo,
po.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,
po.putaway_status AS status,
u.real_name AS operatorName,
po.gmt_create AS createdTime, po.putaway_time AS putawayTime,
po.remark
FROM putaway_order po
LEFT JOIN receipt_order ro ON ro.id = po.receipt_order_id
LEFT JOIN inbound_order io ON io.id = po.inbound_order_id
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = po.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = po.operator_id
ORDER BY po.gmt_create DESC, po.id DESC

SELECT poi.id, poi.putaway_order_id AS putawayOrderId, poi.inbound_order_item_id AS inboundOrderItemId, poi.sku_id AS skuId, poi.location_id AS locationId, wl.location_code AS locationCode, poi.putaway_qty AS putawayQty, poi.gmt_create AS createdTime
FROM putaway_order_item poi
LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wl ON wl.id = poi.location_id
ORDER BY poi.putaway_order_id, poi.id

SELECT id, putaway_order_no AS putawayOrderNo, inbound_order_id AS inboundOrderId, putaway_status AS putawayStatus
FROM putaway_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO putaway_order ( putaway_order_no, inbound_order_id, receipt_order_id, warehouse_id, operator_id, putaway_status, putaway_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{putawayOrderNo}, #{inboundOrderId}, #{receiptOrderId}, #{warehouseId}, #{operatorId}, #{putawayStatus}, #{putawayTime}, #{remark} )

INSERT INTO putaway_order_item ( putaway_order_id, inbound_order_item_id, receipt_order_item_id, sku_id, location_id, putaway_qty ) VALUES ( #{putawayOrderId}, #{inboundOrderItemId}, ( SELECT roi.id FROM putaway_order po JOIN receipt_order_item roi ON roi.receipt_order_id = po.receipt_order_id WHERE po.id = #{putawayOrderId} AND roi.inbound_order_item_id = #{inboundOrderItemId} ), #{skuId}, #{locationId}, #{putawayQty} )

INSERT INTO inventory_transaction ( inventory_id, putaway_order_item_id, change_qty, before_qty, after_qty ) SELECT id, #{id}, #{putawayQty}, quantity - #{putawayQty}, quantity FROM inventory WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.update: UPDATE putaway_order SET putaway_status = 2, putaway_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND putaway_status = 1
